text_block_list.text: While walking down the hallway, I spotted Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*...
Dammit, it's still flickering in the back of my mind.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer...
Listen to this, I went to see a movie with Scarlet on our day off...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The one I picked at random turned out to be a... a romance flick...
They were just making out and flirting non-stop on screen, man!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That scene was burned into my mind the whole time
and I barely got any sleep, dammit!
choice_data_list: What kind of scene was it?
What kind of scene was it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Daaaaamn it!
What are you making me say?!"

Perhaps feeling a nosebleed coming on,
Vodka held her nose with a hand
and wandered off somewhere.
